name: Cave Bat
assessment: No visible bat body in either neutral capture or a focused actual-game browser scene on this machine, despite visible entity/valid mesh bounds. Do not award an anatomy score from the filename. Packaged/native reproduction still needed.

name: Animated Statue
assessment: Golem key loads a floating winged green creature, not a humanoid civic statue; no stone figure, spear or planted feet.

name: Stone Knuckle
assessment: Floating winged Goleling is not a planted pebble elemental; no dense stone core or blunt hands.

name: Clay Helper
assessment: Smaller floating winged Goleling has no clay humanoid body, broad hands, feet or maker marks.

name: Kobold Emberkeeper
assessment: Green orc lacks copper scales, dragon head, tail and illustrated wings; no travelling brazier.

name: Air Elemental
assessment: Skull-faced floating ghost replaces a hollow vortex of dust, leaves and cloud; transparency alone does not supply wind anatomy.

name: Cinder Strider
assessment: Same squat winged imp; no tall narrow flame body, long ember limbs or trailing smoke.

name: Kobold Trapkeeper
assessment: Green orc humanoid has no reptile muzzle, scales, tail or clawed feet; dart case and tools absent.

name: Kobold Tunnel Scout
assessment: Same tailless green orc as trapkeeper; no reptilian head, dart launcher, ribbon, chalk or twine.

name: Emberling
assessment: Red winged imp with horns and pitchfork rather than a small body of coals and flame.

name: Wererat
assessment: Human lumberjack with sword; no rat head, tail, digitigrade legs, thief coat or small knife.

name: Plague Zombie
assessment: Same tinted lumberjack as ghoul; no burial wrapping, swelling, decomposition or grave flies.

name: Werebear
assessment: Stitched hooded humanoid monstrosity has neither bear head nor bear paws/fur; not recognizable as a werebear.

name: Ash Demon
assessment: Same solid cartoon imp, without animal-like smoke/fire body or soot; not distinct from other Demon-key creatures.

name: Hobgoblin Marshal
assessment: Same green brute as warband melee units; no officer's helm/map board or readable marshal identity.

name: Crypt Ghoul
assessment: Healthy lumberjack proportions in red shirt with brown/green tint; no gaunt corpse anatomy, stretched lips or long nails.

name: Ghast
assessment: Broad stitched hooded monster instead of taut, long-nailed undead in stolen finery; same body as werebear.

name: Hobgoblin Shieldguard
assessment: Orc brute instead of disciplined hobgoblin; sword and small round shield replace spear and rectangular shield.

name: Grave Wisp
assessment: Dark skull-faced ghost is not a pale drifting light with an indistinct inner face; same Ghost body as shadow/wraith.

name: Goblin Firestarter
assessment: Barehanded orc proxy; goggles, bottles and fire-bearing equipment absent; indistinguishable from rattlechanter.

name: Goblin Rattlechanter
assessment: Barehanded orc proxy; no bells, pans or rhythm gear to communicate its support role.

name: Shadow
assessment: Volumetric skull-faced ghost, not a person's moving shadow; shared blue tint does not establish shadow material.

name: Wight
assessment: Healthy-looking moustached vampire in a red coat; no armoured corpse, decay or ancient lord's regalia.

name: Goblin Smoke Slinger
assessment: Barehanded orc proxy; no sling, pots or mouth scarf; visually duplicates the other goblin specialists.

name: Goblin Spearhand
assessment: Exactly the scrapper body with a sword; neither spear nor saucepan helmet is rendered.

name: Glass Sentinel
assessment: Opaque icy crystal brute rather than a clear reflective glass humanoid with coloured seams; identical to ice warden.

name: Hobgoblin Longbow
assessment: Bow is present, but green lightly clothed orc replaces reddish disciplined armoured hobgoblin; quiver/bowcase absent.

name: Horned Devil
assessment: Horns/wings read as generic devil; pitchfork replaces chains and ledger, no enforcer regalia or rank silhouette.

name: Orc Warcaller
assessment: Same armoured brute as shieldbreaker; no drum or staff, with a visible sword-like prop instead.

name: Grave Cultist
assessment: Cheerful orange-hatted witch, glasses and skirt; no ash robes, burial tokens or ritual relic; identical to hedge sorcerer.

name: Goblin Boss
assessment: Small-scale heavily armoured orc brute with trophies, not a goblin officer in an oversized pocketed coat.

name: Wraith
assessment: Floating ghost silhouette broadly works; large skull replaces torn robe/two pale sparks; no distinction from other Ghost entries.

name: Lich — Tomb Sage
assessment: Necromancer mage reads as caster, but living-looking face, neat outfit and no books miss preserved undead scholar/blackened bones.

name: Clockwork Scout
assessment: Mechanical robot is recognizable, but large barrel torso/twin exhausts and arms replace small brass surveying device with lens and jointed feet.

name: Goblin Scrapper
assessment: Small green orc proxy reads broadly goblinoid; broad head/short ears miss wiry goblin anatomy and scavenger pockets.

name: Barrow Guard
assessment: Oversized bare skeletal brute rather than an armoured burial guardian; sword/shield only partly convey the role.

name: Orc Shieldbreaker
assessment: Armoured orc brute fits strength but has sword instead of hooked axe; excessive shoulders/trophies, no shield-boss belt.

name: Dire Wolf
assessment: Only 15% larger than wolf; no broad muzzle, winter ruff or distinct heavy build.

name: Hell Hound
assessment: Brown/red version of blocky wolf, without black coat, furnace mouth or convincing flame; not a distinct infernal body.

name: Mire Ooze
assessment: Blob communicates slime, but the prominent cartoon eye contradicts eyelessness; lacks mud texture and suspended scraps.

name: Hedge Sorcerer
assessment: Witch silhouette implies caster, but no visible focus/charms; identical to cultist and markedly brighter than reference.

name: Winter Wolf
assessment: Blue-grey version of wolf; lacks white fur, pronounced mane and visible icy mouth; distinction is mainly tint.

name: Wolf
assessment: Recognizable quadruped canine but extremely blocky, short-legged and without dense fur/long muzzle; shares all wolf variants.

name: Cinder Imp
assessment: Small horned winged fiend fits; flat red body/pitchfork miss coal skin, grasping claws and a clearly readable barbed tail.

name: Skeleton Champion
assessment: Same horned warrior body as sentry; shield helps but crooked crown and veteran regalia are absent.

name: Orc Outrider
assessment: Orc species and blade are recognizable; squat chibi proportions and sparse travel gear miss the long-legged scout.

name: Death Knight
assessment: Armoured closed-helm knight reads correctly; bright plume and generic sword/shield lack burned heraldry and spectral menace; same body as animated armour.

name: Werewolf
assessment: Wolf-headed humanoid with claws reads; tidy red lumberjack shirt and modest arms miss torn cuffs and powerful hybrid bulk.

name: Animated Armor
assessment: Closed armour, sword and shield fit; emptiness is not demonstrated, bright plume/cape match death knight exactly.

name: Bandit Bow
assessment: Human and bow are correct, but black/red ninja mask and topknot replace camouflaged roadside archer.

name: Masked Duelist
assessment: Masked sword-user reads, but ninja topknot/face covering replace distinctive duelling mask, light coat and fine blade.

name: Skeleton Sentry
assessment: Correct skeleton and sword; horned helmet replaces exposed skull, uniform tatters and the illustrated shield are missing.

name: Giant Rat
assessment: Rat body, four legs, rounded ears and long tail read; smooth primitives lack fur, scars and thick tail.

name: Shield Soldier
assessment: Human armour, sword and shield read as soldier; blue heroic cape and bright heraldry replace weathered service gear.

name: Icebound Warden
assessment: Broad ice/crystal humanoid with blunt fists is a good semantic fit; crystalline spikes replace layered lake ice and bubble eyes.

name: Road Bandit
assessment: Human survivalist, practical clothes, belt gear and blade communicate robber well; missing ragged cloak/pack detail.

name: Skeleton Archer
assessment: Clearly a skeleton archer with bow; hood obscures skull, quiver and ragged uniform are missing.

name: Giant Spider
assessment: Eight legs, segmented abdomen, clustered eyes and fangs read clearly; simple legs lack hooked feet and silk glands.
